subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] mm: page_alloc: fix non-movable reclaim storm in defrag_mode

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a mistake in the patch and asked reviewer Andrew to fold the diff into the original patch.
reviews.raw_body:
Yes, good catch. Thanks.

Andrew, would you mind folding this difflet in place?

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch fixes a 'reclaim storm' issue in the Linux kernel's page allocation system, specifically in defrag_mode. The problem occurs when non-movable requests spin in reclaim, causing excessive swapping and pressure spikes on certain workloads. To fix this, the patch sends non-movable requests into pageblock reclaim/compaction, allowing them to help move pages along and meet the ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT bar. This approach is a temporary solution until a more comprehensive fix can be implemented to address scaling and concurrency limitations in compaction.
